requirements.statement: A successfully completed LDRD writes the two returned words to its even/odd destination pair, STRD writes no destination registers, and pending base writeback commits only after successful completion.

On a precise LDRD Data Abort, values in the two non-base destination registers are architecturally UNPREDICTABLE rather than preserved; any specified base writeback is suppressed by the ARM9E-S base-restored abort model. STRD also suppresses base writeback on a precise abort.
